# ImageBuffer

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Images](BlitzBasic-Images)

```blitzbasic
ImageBuffer image%, frame%=0  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Returns the buffer of one frame of an image, which [SetBuffer](SetBuffer) can make the target of all drawing commands. The buffer is also the one that [LockBuffer](LockBuffer) and [ReadPixel](ReadPixel) work on.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local img = CreateImage(32, 32, 2)
SetBuffer ImageBuffer(img, 0)
Color 255, 0, 0
Rect 0, 0, 32, 32, 1
SetBuffer ImageBuffer(img, 1)
Color 0, 0, 255
Rect 0, 0, 32, 32, 1
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
DrawImage img, 60, 100, 0
DrawImage img, 140, 100, 1
Flip
WaitKey
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `image` | Int | required | The image. |
| `frame` | Int | `0` | The frame whose buffer to return. Defaults to 0. |

**Returns:** A buffer handle for [SetBuffer](SetBuffer) and the pixel commands.

**Differences and known gaps:**

* A frame number that does not exist stops the program with an error message.
